guarantees.claim: When compile-time parameter EnMasking is true, prefix_data[0] is driven to constant '0, and prefix_data[1] is driven to prefix_sliced.
When compile-time parameter EnMasking is false, prefix_data[0] is driven to prefix_sliced, and prefix_data[1] is not driven from this generate block.

assumptions.claim: The parameter EnMasking must match the declared array dimension of prefix_data, such that when EnMasking is false, only prefix_data[0] exists (no higher index) or is intentionally unused.
assumptions.risk: If EnMasking is false but prefix_data is declared with two or more elements, prefix_data[1] is undriven, potentially causing X propagation or unintended exposure of unmasked share values on the second share.

assumptions.claim: prefix_sliced must hold a valid (non-X) logic value whenever it is used to drive prefix_data.
assumptions.cond: When the corresponding generate branch is active
assumptions.risk: An X in prefix_sliced would propagate to prefix_data, corrupting the SHA-3 padding and potentially leading to protocol failure or cryptographic incorrectness.

uncertain_points.claim: In the unmasked branch (EnMasking = 0), only prefix_data[0] is assigned. If the actual array declaration of prefix_data includes more than one element (e.g., two shares), the higher-index elements are undriven, which could result in simulation X or synthesis latch/unknown values, possibly leaking unmasked data or violating masking security.
uncertain_points.cond: EnMasking is false and prefix_data has >1 elements
